brief:
Palestinian farmer and human rights defender Ghassan Najjar was arrested by Israeli forces, Al Jazeera English reported. Najjar has worked documenting rights violations and advocating for Palestinians affected by Israeli military operations.

The arrest follows a pattern of Israeli detention of Palestinian activists and civil society figures who document alleged abuses and coordinate resistance to settlement expansion and military actions in occupied territories.
dek: Palestinian farmer and human rights defender Ghassan Najjar was arrested by Israeli forces.
title: Israeli forces arrest Palestinian human rights defender Ghassan Najjar
